text:
emily.g: quick check-in 1 i keep seeing noisy flips between fp8/int8/4-bit mid-request. thinking of a tiny 'bitwidth policy' evaluated once per request with a token-lock window. sharing sketch.

raj.k: looks useful. what are the decision signals?

emily.g: start minimal: degradation_score (0-1), token_zone (head|mid|tail), kv_cache_miss_rate, model_adapter_support, customer_pin. output: ordered allowed_bitpaths + reason_tag + lock_tokens.

taylor: example rule pls?

emily.g: example: 
```
rule a_tail_cached {
 when ds < 0.03 and token_zone == tail and kv_cache_miss_rate < 0.05
 allow: [fp8, int8]
 lock_tokens: 64
 reason: "low risk tail + cached kv"
}
rule b_conservative {
 when ds < 0.06 and model_adapter_support contains fp8
 allow: [fp8]
 lock_tokens: 32
}
rule default { allow: [fp32] }
```

morgan: add estimated_risk score per-rule so runtime can present safest-first and telemetry can bucket.

hana-bot: telemetry note: use short hashed rule ids (bw.rule=sha1) and sample full context <=0.5% to avoid cardinality/storage issues. include bw.inputs=(ds,zone,kv_hit) and bw.allowed.

ops-bot: ops concern 1 need circuit-breaker: if latency_p99 on quant path > 1.1x baseline for 5m, pause policy and roll to safe path. also limit full capture sampling to 0.5%.

raj.k: runtime compatibility question: some fused kernels don't support certain bitpaths.

emily.g: runtime must call model_adapter.supported_bitpaths(model_id) and intersect with policy allow. if empty -> fallback_kind = "higher_fidelity_variant" or route to non-quant path; tag decision with fallback_kind and reason.

taylor: oscillation is a huge risk. how to prevent token-by-token switches?

emily.g: token-lock prevents it; also require changes only at sentence boundary or when avg_confidence_stability(window) > threshold; enforce max one change per-request.

morgan: rollout plan idea: shadow mode 14d @ 3-5% traffic, paired evaluation vs current heuristic per-cohort (intent, customer). metrics: exact-match delta, nll delta, hallucination proxy.

hana-bot: define auto-disable triggers in telemetry: e.g., cohort exact-match drop > 0.4% absolute OR hallucination proxy up > 0.2% absolute -> pause for that cohort.

emily.g: agree. add quality escrow window: if we detect regression within escrow, block and roll back.

raj.k: for reproducibility, when sampled store prompt_hash, model_version, kv_prefix_hash and deterministic_seed; do privacy redaction.

ops-bot: config precedence: customer_pin > endpoint_flag > policy_default. control-plane computes final allowed_bitpaths and hands to runtime.

taylor: runtime API suggestion: GET /v1/bitwidth-decision?inputs=... returns {rule_hash, allowed_bitpaths, risk_score, lock_tokens, explain_tag}. helpful for dev replay.

morgan: metrics to ship: decisions.count, choices.fp8_pct, choices.4bit_pct, avg_degradation_by_choice, latency_p95_by_choice, rollback.count. keep names short.

emily.g: i'll draft a short RFC with: 1) policy grammar, 2) runtime adapter contract, 3) telemetry fields + sampling plan, 4) rollout/shadowing + thresholds, 5) ops circuit-breaker playbook. will ping for reviewers. :sparkles:
